title: ASD-FEAT: A Multi-Modal Infant Video-Derived Dataset for Early ASD Risk Prediction — code release
description:
Code accompanying the paper ASD-FEAT: A Multi-Modal Infant Video-Derived Dataset for Early ASD Risk Prediction. It implements the two-stage pipeline: Stage 1 trains and runs transformer behavior detectors (Look-Face, Look-Object, Smile, Social-Vocalization) over per-frame multi-modal features; Stage 2 summarizes those behavior labels into per-session aggregate features and trains/evaluates the ASD-risk classifiers, including the within-visit partner-contrast analyses.

The ASD-FEAT dataset itself is distributed separately via Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22261227) and contains derived features only, with no raw video or audio.
